ir.name: ref_all_pairs_builder
ir.intuition: Reference builder: all winner/loser pairs by objective ordering.

ir.name: energy_based_pairwise_advantage_loss
ir.intuition: Reformulate the preference loss as an energy-based model where the energy difference between winning and losing pairs is modulated by advantage signals, using a sigmoid probability interpretation with a softplus penalty for misordering. This paradigm shifts from margin-based contrastive losses to an energy difference framework, combining the advantage signal multiplicatively to weight energies. Aggregation uses mean to promote smoothness. The loss encourages minimal energy for preferred samples while penalizing reversed order softly.
ir.pseudocode:
e_w = (log_prob_w - log_prob_l) * sigmoid(advantage_gap)
e_l = (log_prob_l - log_prob_w) * sigmoid(-advantage_gap)
loss_w = softplus(e_w)
loss_l = softplus(e_l)
pair_loss = (loss_w + loss_l) * weight
final_loss = mean(pair_loss)
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    weight = batch['weight']
    advantage_gap = batch['advantage_gap']
    pos_sigmoid = ops.sigmoid(advantage_gap)
    neg_sigmoid = ops.sigmoid(ops.neg(advantage_gap))
    e_w = ops.mul(ops.sub(lpw, lpl), pos_sigmoid)
    e_l = ops.mul(ops.sub(lpl, lpw), neg_sigmoid)
    loss_w = ops.softplus(e_w)
    loss_l = ops.softplus(e_l)
    loss = ops.mul(ops.add(loss_w, loss_l), weight)
    return ops.mean(loss)
